paragraphs.text: 1. THE sapient with their spirit and their mind behold the Bird adorned with all an Asura's magic might.
paragraphs.original: पतंगमक्तमसुरस्य मायया हृदा पश्यन्ति मनसा विपश्चितः ।
paragraphs.translit: pataṃgamaktamasurasya māyayā hṛdā paśyanti manasā vipaścitaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Sages observe him in the ocean's inmost depth: the wise disposers seek the station of his rays.
paragraphs.original: समुद्रे अन्तः कवयो वि चक्षते मरीचीनां पदमिच्छन्ति वेधसः
paragraphs.translit: samudre antaḥ kavayo vi cakṣate marīcīnāṃ padamicchanti vedhasaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. The flying Bird bears Speech within his spirit: erst the Gandharva in the womb pronounced it:
paragraphs.original: पतंगो वाचं मनसा बिभर्ति तां गन्धर्वोऽवदद्गर्भे अन्तः ।
paragraphs.translit: pataṃgo vācaṃ manasā bibharti tāṃ gandharvo'vadadgarbhe antaḥ |

paragraphs.text: And at the seat of sacrifice the sages cherish this radiant, heavenly-bright invention.
paragraphs.original: तां द्योतमानां स्वर्यं मनीषामृतस्य पदे कवयो नि पान्ति
paragraphs.translit: tāṃ dyotamānāṃ svaryaṃ manīṣāmṛtasya pade kavayo ni pānti

paragraphs.text: 3. I saw the Herdsman, him who never resteth, approaching and departing on his pathways.
paragraphs.original: अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम् ।
paragraphs.translit: apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam |

paragraphs.text: He, clothed in gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.
paragraphs.original: स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः
paragraphs.translit: sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ
